messages:
zoe: hey team — new hire here (zoe). trying to run my first Buildkite pipeline but the publish step fails with `unauthorized: authentication required` when pushing to ghcr.io. i'm on the infra team so wondering what perms i'm missing.
sam: welcome! :wave: do you have a PAT/token configured in Buildkite? GHCR pushes need a token with `write:packages` (or a machine user).
zoe: i added a secret called GHCR_TOKEN in the pipeline. logs show: 
```
# docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/my-app:ci-123
failed to copy: unauthorized: authentication required
```
zoe: i thought org SSO would handle this automatically? the GitHub app for Buildkite also shows "Not installed" on the repo settings for me.
eli: org SSO can block personal tokens. we usually create a machine user or a PAT from a user who has packages:write and isn't blocked by SSO. in the pipeline we do: `echo "$GHCR_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u redwood-ci-bot --password-stdin` then push.
sam: also double-check the Buildkite secret is marked as a pipeline env (not just a team secret), and that it's masked. in some repos we use the env name `GHCR_PAT` specifically.
buildkite-bot: Pipeline build #54 failed — step "publish-image" exited with status 1.
zoe: i tried `docker login` locally with my PAT and it worked, but i don't have access to org installations so i can't see if Buildkite app is installed. getting 403 on the org installations page.
eli: okay, give me your github handle and i'll add you to the `ci-deployers` team and/or create a machine user. if you want we can also create a repo-scoped machine token so it's not tied to your personal account.
zoe: github handle is z_luna
sam: created machine user `redwood-ci-bot`, granted packages:write on the repo, generated PAT, and added it to the pipeline as `GHCR_PAT` (masked). also installed Buildkite app for the repo. ping me if you still can't see installs.
buildkite-bot: Build started: #55 (branch: onboarding/zoe-first-build)
zoe: ✅ build #55 passed! thanks so much. two quick q's: 1) where's the short onboarding doc for creating PATs and machine users? 2) who do i ping for secret rotations?
eli: doc lives at `docs/dev/onboarding/ci.md` (we should add a GHCR + SSO note). for rotations ping `#eng-infra` and tag @sam; we'll rotate the machine user PAT and update the pipeline secrets. i'll make a small PR to add the SSO note.
zoe: perfect — appreciate the quick help :tada: 
sam: welcome aboard! if you want i can walk you through the rest of the pipeline steps later today.
